data.EntryRequirement: nternational Applicants will be selected for admission based on the following criteria:  A Bachelor’s degree that has been recognised as equivalent to an Australian Bachelor’s degree, AQF Level 7 and which has been taught and assessed in English within the last 10 years, or to be in the final year of an eligible Bachelor’s degree. An overall weighted Grade Point Average of 5.2 or higher on a 7 point scale, calculated from the applicant’s most recent three years of undergraduate study. Unweighted GAMSAT Score of at least 50 (in all sections and overall) or overall MCAT score of at least 500. This year the School of Medicine is using a live online panel interview for all international candidates. This is to help all of us to get to know each other. All candidates will be asked the same interview questions by the panel and there will be an opportunity for you to ask questions at the end.

data.Name: CERTIFICATE III IN COMMERCIAL COOKERY and CERTIFICATE IV IN KITCHEN MANAGEMENT and ADVANCED DIPLOMA OF HOSPITALITY MANAGEMENT
data.EntryRequirement: Satisfactory completion of Australia Year 11 or equivalent interstate/overseas secondary education is required.
data.Remarks:
"The program is offered as a packaged pathway comprising the following qualifications: • Certificate III in Commercial Cookery (SIT30821) – 15 months (9 months of study + 6 months Work Integrated Learning (WIL) Internship) • Certificate IV in Kitchen Management (SIT40521) – 6 months • Advanced Diploma of Hospitality Management (SIT60322) – 6 months
Prerequisites: • The prerequisite for the Certificate IV in Kitchen Management (SIT40521) is the successful completion of the Certificate III in Commercial Cookery (SIT30821).
• The prerequisite for the Advanced Diploma of Hospitality Management (SIT60322) is the successful completion of the Certificate IV in Kitchen Management (SIT40521).
• Therefore, when these qualifications are packaged together, the total program duration is 27 months.

- Indicative Tuition Fees:
• Certificate III in Commercial Cookery (15 months): AU$41,985
• Certificate IV in Kitchen Management (6 months): AU$13,801
• Advanced Diploma of Hospitality Management (6 months): AU$14,597
Please note: The tuition fees are indicative only and are subject to change."

"• The Advanced Diploma of Hospitality Management offers a comprehensive pathway for students aspiring to build a successful career in the hospitality industry. • To progress through the program, students must successfully complete the following qualifications in sequence: • SIT31021 Certificate III in Patisserie • SIT40721 Certificate IV in Patisserie • SIT60322 Advanced Diploma of Hospitality Management • This structured pathway equips students with the knowledge, practical skills, and industry experience required for supervisory and management roles across a wide range of hospitality sectors. • Throughout the program, students will develop essential leadership and management capabilities in key areas, including:
• Marketing • Human Resource Management • Business Planning • Financial Management • Operational Leadership • Graduates will be well prepared to pursue rewarding careers in hospitality management with the confidence and expertise to lead teams and manage business operations effectively.
• The program is combined with - CERTIFICATE III IN PATISSERIE (15 months, 9 months + 6 months WIL Internship) + CERTIFICATE IV IN PATISSERIE (6 months) + ADVANCED DIPLOMA OF
HOSPITALITY MANAGEMENT (6 Months) - • The prerequisite for the Certificate IV in Patisserie (SIT40721) is the successful completion of the Certificate III in Patisserie (SIT31021). • The prerequisite for the Advanced Diploma of Hospitality Management (SIT60322) is the successful completion of the Certificate IV in Patisserie (SIT40721). • Therefore, when these qualifications are undertaken as a packaged pathway, the total program duration is 27 months.
Tution Fee: -

• CERTIFICATE IV IN PATISSERIE (6 Months) - AU$13,081
• ADVANCED DIPLOMA OF HOSPITALITY MANAGEMENT (6 Months) – AU$ 14597
• The tuition fee is indicative and subject to change"

data.Name: Bachelor of Data Science
data.universityName: SP Jain School of Global Management
data.EntryRequirement: All applicants (domestic and international) are expected to have completed a minimum of 12 years of schooling demonstrated by one or more of the following: - Completion of an Australian Senior Secondary Certificate of Education authorised by a relevant state-based issuing agency with an Australian Tertiary Admission Rank (ATAR) or its interstate equivalent of 70; or Completion of an accredited vocational education and training (VET) qualification at Diploma or Advanced Diploma level completed at an ASQA registered training organisation (RTO); or All India Senior School Certificate (issued by CBSE) or the India School Certificate (ISC) or the Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) Year 12 exam from the Indian State Board with a score of 60% or more; or International Baccalaureate Diploma (IB) score of 24 or more; or Completion of an international qualification where the content, level and intended outcomes are deemed to be equivalent to any of the above through official qualification recognition register or mapping of equivalence by the School. In lieu of above, completion of minimum years of 11 years of schooling for the nine Commonwealth of International States (CIS) countries subject to a minimum CGPA score of 4.00 out of 5.00 issued by the National Board in these countries. :- All eligible applicants must take one of the following tests—SAT (Code 7579), ACT (Code 1473), SPJET, or JEE (Main)—and achieve the minimum required scores as per the Undergraduate Admission Policy, including at least 600 in SAT Math or 75% in SPJET Numeracy, with shortlisted SPJET candidates required to pay a USD 45 fee to schedule the test, while final admission decisions may also consider academic performance and extracurricular achievements. Shortlisted applicants - selected based on academic performance, English proficiency, and aptitude test scores- will be notified in writing and must complete the final evaluation stage, which includes two essays and a personal interview (on campus or online), along with payment of a non-refundable USD 55 evaluation fee, noting that both entrance test and evaluation fees are non-refundable under any circumstances.
data.Remarks:
Evaluation fee is INR 4500, it is converted at the exchange rate of 1AUD = 68 INR
For more information, please visit the university website.

data.Name: Bachelor of Economics
data.universityName: SP Jain School of Global Management
data.EntryRequirement: Academic Entry Requirement: Successful completion of 12 years of schooling with one of the following: Australian Year 12 (ATAR 70), Diploma/Advanced Diploma from an ASQA RTO, CBSE/ISC with 60%, Indian State Board HSC with 70%, IB Diploma with 24 points, or an equivalent international qualification; all education must be completed in English with certified evidence, while applicants from the nine CIS countries may qualify with 11 years of schooling and a minimum CGPA of 4.0/5.0.
data.Remarks:
The Scholastic Aptitude Test (SAT): The SAT is administered by the College Board in the USA and is a measure of critical thinking skills. The minimum score required to be considered for admission for all diploma and undergraduate courses is 1000; or
The American College Testing (ACT): ACT test covers four academic skill areas: English, mathematics, reading, and science reasoning. The minimum score required to be considered for admission for all diploma and undergraduate courses is 23; or
The SP Jain Entrance Test (SPJET): is designed and developed by S P Jain to assess a broad range of numeracy and literacy skills. The minimum score required to be considered for admission for all diploma and undergraduate courses is 50%; or
Additionally, the School requires the BEC applicants to meet the minimum requirements of 600 in the Math section of the SAT; 20 in the Math section of the ACT, or a minimum 75% in the Numeracy section of the SPJET. For more information, please visit the university website.

data.Name: CERTIFICATE III IN COMMERCIAL COOKERY and CERTIFICATE IV IN KITCHEN MANAGEMENT and ADVANCED DIPLOMA OF HOSPITALITY MANAGEMENT
data.EntryRequirement: Satisfactory completion of Australia Year 11 or equivalent interstate/overseas secondary education is required.
data.Remarks:
The program is offered as a packaged pathway comprising the following qualifications: • Certificate III in Commercial Cookery (SIT30821) – 15 months (9 months of study + 6 months Work Integrated Learning (WIL) Internship) • Certificate IV in Kitchen Management (SIT40521) – 6 months • Advanced Diploma of Hospitality Management (SIT60322) – 6 months
Prerequisites: • The prerequisite for the Certificate IV in Kitchen Management (SIT40521) is the successful completion of the Certificate III in Commercial Cookery (SIT30821).
• The prerequisite for the Advanced Diploma of Hospitality Management (SIT60322) is the successful completion of the Certificate IV in Kitchen Management (SIT40521).
• Therefore, when these qualifications are packaged together, the total program duration is 27 months.

- Indicative Tuition Fees:
• Certificate III in Commercial Cookery (15 months): AU$41,985
• Certificate IV in Kitchen Management (6 months): AU$13,801
• Advanced Diploma of Hospitality Management (6 months): AU$14,597
Please note: The tuition fees are indicative only and are subject to change.

data.EntryRequirement: Satisfactory completion of Australia Year 11 or equivalent interstate/overseas secondary education is required.
data.Remarks:
"• The Advanced Diploma of Hospitality Management offers a comprehensive pathway for students aspiring to build a successful career in the hospitality industry. • To progress through the program, students must successfully complete the following qualifications in sequence: • SIT31021 Certificate III in Patisserie • SIT40721 Certificate IV in Patisserie • SIT60322 Advanced Diploma of Hospitality Management • This structured pathway equips students with the knowledge, practical skills, and industry experience required for supervisory and management roles across a wide range of hospitality sectors. • Throughout the program, students will develop essential leadership and management capabilities in key areas, including:
• Marketing • Human Resource Management • Business Planning • Financial Management • Operational Leadership • Graduates will be well prepared to pursue rewarding careers in hospitality management with the confidence and expertise to lead teams and manage business operations effectively.
• The program is combined with - CERTIFICATE III IN PATISSERIE (15 Month, 9 months + 6 month WIL Internship) + CERTIFICATE IV IN PATISSERIE (6 Month) + ADVANCED DIPLOMA OF
HOSPITALITY MANAGEMENT (6 Month) - • The prerequisite for the Certificate IV in Patisserie (SIT40721) is the successful completion of the Certificate III in Patisserie (SIT31021). • The prerequisite for the Advanced Diploma of Hospitality Management (SIT60322) is the successful completion of the Certificate IV in Patisserie (SIT40721). • Therefore, when these qualifications are undertaken as a packaged pathway, the total program duration is 27 months.
Tution Fee : - 
• Certificate III in Patisserie (SIT31021) (15 Month) - AU$ 41,985
• CERTIFICATE IV IN PATISSERIE (6 Month) - AU$13,081
• ADVANCED DIPLOMA OF HOSPITALITY MANAGEMENT (6 Month) – AU$ 14597
• The tuition fee is indicative and subject to change"
